  "pros": [
    "Simplified project management for complex tasks",
    "Ability to link multiple Smartsheet documents to centralized dashboards",
    "Reliable performance and a secure platform for data"
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Initial learning curve can be steep for new users",
    "Limited customization options compared to other tools",
    "Fickle copy/paste functionality and inability to edit multiple lines simultaneously"
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This System Administrator experienced Smartsheet as a highly functional and reliable tool for managing projects and tracking ad sales within a large IT organization. They found its core project management capabilities to be very effective, especially appreciating the ability to consolidate information into dashboards. While the initial setup and certain interface limitations presented minor frustrations, the overall stability and robust features made it a valuable asset for their role."
